why_relevant: Largest social-insurance payer; buys account services, mass payment processing and increasingly card/e-payment acceptance (its e-services route payments via Štátna pokladnica with cards, Google Pay, Apple Pay and bank payment buttons).

source_name: Všeobecná zdravotná poisťovňa — Profil verejného obstarávateľa
why_relevant: State health insurer, procurement volume in tens–hundreds of millions EUR; publishes tender documentation PDFs directly on its own domain (easier to parse than the ÚVO portal).

Postal operator with the densest cash/counter network in SK and a card-acceptance + SK PAY estate; the single most payment-hardware-relevant buyer in the cell. Page states it acts under §9(1)(b) of Act 343/2015 and routes tenders through ERANET.
Actual live tender list for Slovenská pošta, including commercial (below-threshold) tenders that never reach the ÚVO bulletin.

source_name: ŽSR — Obstarávanie v podmienkach ŽSR / Verejné obstarávanie
why_relevant: Rail infrastructure manager (procurement centralised in Centrum logistiky a obstarávania); buyer of station ticketing, cash handling and payment acceptance at counters.
JOSEPHINE is one of the two dominant SK e-procurement systems; the ŽSR instance carries live tenders, clarifications (vysvetlenia) and Q&A that reveal technical requirements before award.
Second major SK e-procurement platform; buyer-scoped subdomain paths (/<buyer>/) make per-buyer monitoring cheap, and it carries below-threshold calls.

National passenger rail operator; repeatedly procuring a new ticketing/sales system (iKVC replacement, ~EUR 14m tender cancelled once), which bundles e-shop, mobile app, counter cash registers and card acceptance.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska — Prípravné trhové konzultácie
why_relevant: Central bank publishes named PTK pages with per-consultation detail; as cash-cycle and payment-system operator it is an adjacent but high-signal buyer, and its PTK page structure is a model for tracking early demand.
Defines how and where SK buyers must document PTKs (incl. via IS EVO), telling the collector exactly which artefacts to look for on buyer profiles as the earliest demand signal.

source_name: uvostat.sk — buyer dossiers (Slovenská pošta id 13342, ŽSR id 11186)
why_relevant: Third-party analytical mirror of ÚVO bulletin data, buyer-keyed; far easier to query historically than the ÚVO portal, useful to reconstruct each buyer's contract history and incumbent suppliers.
Commercial tender-alert mirror indexed by buyer IČO; convenient fallback when the ÚVO portal blocks automated access.

source_name: Postoj — coverage of ÚVO ruling extending procurement duty to Dôvera and Union
why_relevant: Reveals a structural change in the buyer universe: private health insurers Dôvera and Union may become obliged buyers, which would add two large new procurement profiles for banking/payment services.

source_name: teraz.sk — TASR procurement reporting on state buyers
why_relevant: State news agency reports launches, values and cancellations of large state-buyer tenders (e.g. Slovenská pošta logistics IS ~EUR 13.7m) often on the day of publication — a low-latency trigger to go look at the buyer profile.

source_name: U.S. Commercial Service — Slovakia: Selling to the Public Sector
why_relevant: English-language orientation on how SK public procurement works (ÚVO bulletin, register of economic operators, participation prerequisites) — useful for onboarding non-Slovak analysts and validating the pipeline's assumptions.

Second most-used e-procurement platform in SK (~22% of contracts) and a favourite for low-value municipal contracts (zákazky s nízkou hodnotou) that never reach the bulletin — exactly the segment where parking/ticketing pilots are bought.
~8% of Slovak e-procurement volume; used by municipalities and municipal firms. Public list of live calls including small payments/ticketing purchases.
~8% share of SK e-procurement, widely used by regional/municipal buyers; hosts buyer-specific tender portals that must be enumerated to catch sub-threshold calls.

source_subtype: state electronic marketplace / dynamic purchasing system
why_relevant: Mandatory state marketplace for common goods/services below thresholds; municipalities buy commodity items here (card terminals, parking machine spares, cash-in-transit services). Contract detail pages are individually addressable and archived.

source_name: Zverejňovanie Bratislava – register zmlúv, objednávok a faktúr mesta a mestských podnikov (vrátane DPB)
why_relevant: City-of-Bratislava disclosure portal covering the capital and its subsidiaries (Dopravný podnik Bratislava, IČO 00492736) — the single most important municipal buyer for in-vehicle contactless validators and the PAAS parking scheme.
Own-noticeboard tender listing of the largest Slovak municipal transport operator; buys validators, in-vehicle payment terminals, ticket vending machines and fare-collection/cash-handling services.

source_subtype: municipal company site / procurement + tariff pages
why_relevant: Municipal transport operator that contracted Mikroelektronika for 1,331 in-vehicle contactless readers (~EUR 1.49m incl. VAT); its site plus its ÚVO profile document tariff, validator and payment-acceptance procurement.
Introduced combined validators accepting contactless card payment in vehicles from 9 June 2025 — a documented reference deployment and a recurring buyer of acceptance hardware/acquiring services.
The capital's own procurement noticeboard, including výzvy na predkladanie ponúk for low-value contracts (parking scheme components, payment services) that do not reach the ÚVO bulletin.
